name: system.power.logoff
description: Logs the current user off. With `delay_seconds: 0`, the connection may drop before any response. With `delay_seconds > 0`, the OK with `scheduled_at` arrives before logoff is issued. Extra-risky (X) verb; agents may require an elevated tier or explicit policy grant before honouring it.

delay_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before initiating logoff. Zero means immediate.

force_close_apps.description: Force-close applications without prompting. Maps to EWX_FORCE on Windows.

reason.description: Free-form reason logged with the logoff event. Surfaced in Windows Security Event Log.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the OS-level logoff will fire. Equals now+delay_seconds. Only present when delay_seconds > 0.

x-implementations.name: exit_windows_ex
x-implementations.description: Win32 `ExitWindowsEx(EWX_LOGOFF [| EWX_FORCE], dwReason)`. Available NT 4 onwards.

windows-modern.description: ExitWindowsEx(EWX_LOGOFF). Acts on the user's own session; does NOT require SeShutdownPrivilege. Heavily-locked-down builds may still return ERR insufficient_privilege.

windows-classic.description: ExitWindowsEx(EWX_LOGOFF). Available NT 4 onwards. Pre-XP silently ignores `dwReason`.
